notes: Produced a complete robot package integrating the proposed geometry with a tuned PID controller and sensor weights. Adjusted sensor positions to extend coverage to tape edges based on telemetry showing line loss at edges. Controller parameters and line loss strategy are consistent with previous iteration to maintain stability and recovery behavior.
rationale: The previous iteration's telemetry and race outcomes show that increasing sensor size to 0.016 m and widening the wheel track and body width to 0.16 m improved stability and off-track tolerance, but the robot still failed to complete the slalom track, terminating off-track with line loss events. Telemetry indicates line loss mainly occurs at tape edges, suggesting sensor coverage at the edges can be further improved. To address this, I adjusted the sensor positions to extend coverage further to the left and right edges of the tape while maintaining the 5-sensor layout and sensor size at 0.016 m. Wheel radius and body length remain unchanged to preserve speed and agility. The controller uses a PID setup with base_speed 1.2, kp 8.0, ki 0.5, kd 2.0, and sensor weights that steer effectively based on sensor readings. The line_loss strategy remains 'last_direction' to recover from line loss events by steering in the last known direction. The observation request includes key metrics to monitor performance and guide future improvements. This integration aims to reduce line loss events on the slalom track, improve line detection at tape edges, and enhance overall completion and error metrics, especially on challenging tracks.
